posePolicy: Serialized edit-mode pose; Foxy skins reconstructed from bindposes using WoodoLevelPlayable.PrepareFoxySkins algorithm. BakeMesh static fallback only, NOT skeletal animation.
panelPolicy: WoodoLevelPlayable.CollectParts: active descendants; enabled non-particle owned renderers; bounds diagonal >=0.01m; include dontAutoAddToPanel; reset collected members to unplaced; nonzero group IDs merge; ancestor dependencies affect initial order only, not drop eligibility; largest available entry first, stable ties; Fox entry forced first
doorPolicy: Door usable when owner has no panel entry or is placed. Closed doors block any entry with an inside member. Toggle IsOpened; cannot close when canClose=false. Ray hits first, otherwise smallest projected renderer bounds.
foxyPolicy: Only Things and Fox_Head and body supply panel members; nested Fox renderer sets merge into lead. Only Fox entry visible initially; placing Fox reveals Things; BackPack hidden. Rig motion begins on drag and placement; static export does not implement it.
dynamicLimitations: No skeletal weights, clips or runtime deformation exported
Foxy curve motions, clip-relative deltas, notebook live skin repair and completion cutscenes require UE implementation
Geometry is authored scene, not runtime HUD/material/backdrop reconstruction
coordinates: Unity left-handed; metres; +X right,+Y up,+Z forward; quaternion xyzw; world TRS; OBJ local positions, original winding; matrix column-major
